# Both branches change the SAME secret's access groups disjointly. The audit-log
# driver three-way delta-merges the access set; both groups survive and it verifies.

sesam-repo

exec sh -c 'printf "secret\n" > app.env'
exec sesam add app.env --group admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add secret'

# OURS grants ops; THEIRS grants sec (both are change_access on app.env).
exec git checkout -b ours
exec sesam add app.env --group-add ops
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'ours: +ops'

exec git checkout -b theirs ours~1
exec sesam add app.env --group-add sec
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'theirs: +sec'

exec git checkout ours
! exec git merge theirs
exec git commit --no-edit

# The delta-merged access set keeps both grants and the log verifies.
exec sesam verify
exec sesam ls app.env
stdout 'ops'
stdout 'sec'
